finalText:
I wrote the 4.2.0 entry into `CHANGELOG.md`. Out of 380 commits, only 12 things actually matter for users.

One breaking change: an expired token now returns `401` instead of `403`. One new feature: failed webhook deliveries now retry with backoff. The rest are bug fixes, the biggest being a request body that was getting logged in full, and pagination that used to error on a missing cursor across four different endpoints.

Everything else in the history was dependency bumps, refactors, and test churn, so I left it out.
